title: Put on a hat and...
text: Put on a hat and sunscreen lotion, it is a beautiful place with lots to see, even better if you’re a history buff. You need at least 3 hours to go around the whole place. Don’t forget your passport
author: LUIS_M

title: Alhambra
text: Top experience. Something for everyone. Received tickets promptly upon request. Would book here again anytime.
author: Elena_Z

title: Great but risky play
text: Loved the Alhambra, very beautiful piece of history. The booking is more expensive than original pricing from website but it’s great if they are sold out. I received my tickets but it was a little nerve wracking waiting almost a day before to get the tickets. Otherwise everything went fluently. I’m sure they would refund if they couldn’t deliver the tickets but that’s not what most people want when purchasing.
author: Nabeel_A

title: Tips
text: The Alhambra gets booked fast. So book your tickets well in advance. It is huge and takes the day. Be there early well before your entrance time so you can do the gardens before the Palaces. Make sure your camera is fully charged as you will want to a lot of photos and videos. You can take water in. Do not lean on the walls even for a second, or you will be told off.
author: Nicolette_R

title: Lost in history
text: What a great history of Islamic and Spanish history and what a unique 700 to 1500 century artitecture.
author: Rafiq_A

title: Wonderful Alhambra to visit calmly
text: It's a long visit, at least three to four hours. The place is wonderful but very big. Do not miss the buildings.
author: Marina_C

title: Wonderful Alhambra
text:
Alhambra and Nasrid Palace, was one of the 
Most amazing places I have seen. The scale, the Architecture was incredible. Headphones were not included via Viator, we hired these for 8 Euros from another supplier 5 Minutes walk from Alhambra. These were a must.
author: Douglas_S

title: The experience was...
text: The experience was fantastic. The Alhambra is breathtaking. We had tickets for the property plus the palace, but no tour. To tour the full property and palace is between 3-4 hours. We did a day trip from Madrid and did not have much time. Upon arrival, we booked a tour (we were there March 11, so visitors were light). If you have limited time, I highly recommend booking a tour guide, we were taken to the highlights of the property, and the guide was able to navigate us through the lines for the palace. With the guide, we hit the highlights of the property in a short period of time.
author: Nicole_S
